messages:
Lia (design): quick UX check: on narrow phones the Resources table creates horizontal scroll. Proposal: replace table with a swipe-up bottomsheet list at <=420px and keep a condensed top toolbar.
Omar (frontend): good call. Bottomsheet should remove most layout hacks. How to handle search + filters?
Lia (design): toolbar keeps search + crumb. Filters live in a compact pill that opens the sheet focused on filters. Toolbar height reduces to 48px at <=420px.
Jess (product): worried about discoverability for power users. Will the filter pill be obvious?
Omar (frontend): we can animate the pill appearing when results are long and add a subtle badge showing active filters.
Alex (pm): keyboard: tapping inputs may hide sheet under keyboard. Any robust handling?
Lia (design): compute sheet max-height = calc(100vh - toolbarHeight - env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) and recompute on resize/keyboard events; animate with translateY for smoothness.
devex-bot: note: ~22% of page sessions are <=420px last 30d.
Lia (design): accessibility: move focus into sheet on open, trap focus, visible close button, 44px touch targets, announce as dialog.
Omar (frontend): will set role="dialog" aria-modal="true", set background inert, and add a skip link for toolbar focus. Need iOS WKWebView testing for keyboard/viewport quirks.
Jess (product): long IDs shouldn't rely on tooltips. Truncate with inline "Show" toggle that expands inline; expose full text to screen readers offscreen.
Lia (design): truncate rule: first 12 + last 8 characters, show toggle.
Omar (frontend): plan: prototype by Wed, accessibility review Thu, test on iOS/Android. Assigning 2d spike.
Alex (pm): if prototype passes, roll to mobile canary next sprint.
Lia (design): posting mocks in #design later. Omar please drop prototype link when ready. :thumbsup:
